reserveReview.rationale: The replacement Token-2022 mint USDvUSpnhCr9yBgj3UyVrD239HRUv4RsHwH2FxsWuMk is separate from legacy USDv. At finalized Solana slot 447140697, canonical Chancery reserve-authority accounts held 19,998.646 USDC and 999.81 USDG. Their 20,998.456 nominal dollar units define the displayed 95.23864993% / 4.76135007% mix. The same batch read 21,000 outstanding USDv, leaving 1.544 nominal units unreconciled; that gap is not represented as a reserve asset. Both SPL Token and Token-2022 account inventories for the derived reserve authority exposed only those two reserve accounts; the disclosed treasury vault held zero USDC and no Token-2022 balances. These observations establish the on-chain reserve-account mix, not a complete financial reserve examination or market-valued coverage ratio. Current issuer docs name USDC and USDG and describe direct short-dated Treasury exposure as being added; no current Treasury allocation or custodian is evidenced. No legacy Ceffu holdings, derivatives, attestation or supply is inherited.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nominal USD-stablecoin units in the replacement Chancery reserve-authority token accounts at finalized slot 447140697, normalized to their actual 20,998.456-unit balance; selected on-chain reserve scope only
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All assets in the observed reserve-authority account scope are identified. The 1.544-unit difference from same-slot USDv supply remains unreconciled. Any assets, liabilities, encumbrances or Treasury positions outside these accounts are not independently reconciled; zero unknown exposure refers only to the selected account mix, not whole-system completeness.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The observed stablecoins are controlled by the Chancery reserve-authority PDA 8anxfyoftY9hPwxdvReet2beFS2HXjcXraPEamo4nGyB. Program source characterizes reserve compartments as operator-side controls, not customer escrow, FBO, trust or beneficial ownership records. Upgrades are controlled by a separate 3-of-8-member Squads multisig with a two-day delay; live operational and treasury roles have single-signature quorums. No new-token off-chain custodian, legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness or rehypothecation restriction is verified. Circle/Paxos upstream custody is carried through the collateral dependencies, not claimed as direct custody of USDv holders.
